stubs.service: podkrepi-bg NestJS backend API (normally Postgres + Keycloak behind it)
stubs.how: Node http server .ui-capture/stub/server.js serving /api/v1/* from db.json (generated by .ui-capture/stub/seed.js). It runs in-process inside .ui-capture/front.js on a free loopback port; front.js listens on PORT (4486) and routes /api/v1/* and /ghost/* to it, everything else to `next start` (also on a free internal port). NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4486/api/v1 (set in .env.local, baked at build). Write endpoints (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) accept and echo the payload.

Stub returns Keycloak-shaped JWT access/refresh tokens for the seeded user (realm roles include view-supporters + view-contact-requests, so the admin panel is also accessible). Sign in with the real /login form via next-auth credentials provider.
GOOGLE_ID/GOOGLE_SECRET are placeholders; use email/password login instead.

stubs.service: File storage (S3) for campaign / news / blog images
stubs.how: Stub renders category-themed landscape illustrations (SVG -> JPEG via sharp, cached in .ui-capture/stub/img-cache) for /campaign-file/:id, /campaign-news-file/:id and blog feature images.
GHOST_API_URL=http://localhost:4486/ghost; the stub answers /ghost/api/content/posts and /posts/slug/:slug with 12 seeded posts.
Placeholder publishable keys; /stripe/prices* are served by the stub, payment-intent/setup-intent POSTs are echoed. No real checkout is possible offline.

next/font/google is fed by NEXT_FONT_GOOGLE_MOCKED_RESPONSES=.ui-capture/tools/google-fonts-mock.js, which points at the real Commissioner/Montserrat variable fonts from @fontsource-variable npm packages.
No DSN configured (Sentry dry-run in development APP_ENV); GTM only loads after cookie consent and simply fails offline.

notes: Podkrepi.bg (Bulgarian donation platform) frontend, Next.js 14 production build (`next build`, node 24.11.1 + yarn 3.3.0 via mise) run with `next start` on PORT. start.sh runs .ui-capture/front.js, the only process that binds a fixed port (PORT=4486); it hosts the stub API in-process and starts the Next server on a free internal port, proxying to both. Data (deterministic, regenerated by `node .ui-capture/stub/seed.js`): 38 campaigns in Bulgarian across 14 campaign types (active, complete, partially financed, paused, suspended, blocked, draft), ~2,350 donations/payments spread over ~2.5 years in EUR with mixed statuses (succeeded, refund, declined, waiting...), 280+ donor wishes, 55 campaign news articles, 78 expenses, 38 recurring donations, 18 withdrawals, 8 transfers, 160 bank transactions, 161 people, 10 companies, 12 campaign applications, support/contact requests, irregularity reports, documents, bank accounts, 12 blog posts. Signed-in user Десислава Маринова (member since March 2023) has 50+ donations including monthly recurring gifts, organizes 4 campaigns, follows 6 campaigns, and has a pending campaign application. Main areas: home (/), campaigns list (/campaigns) and campaign pages (/campaigns/<slug>, with donations, wishes, news, expenses, statistics), campaign news (/campaigns/news), blog (/blog), profile (/profile/donations, /profile/recurring-donations, /profile/my-campaigns, /profile/my-notifications, /profile/personal-information, /profile/certificates), admin panel (/admin: campaigns, donations, payments, bank transactions, persons, vaults, withdrawals, expenses, campaign applications, etc.). Default locale is Bulgarian; /en/... for English. Build note: yarn install needed a local CONNECT relay (.ui-capture/tools/proxy-relay.js) for the sandbox proxy and removal of .idea/.vscode folders from three cached package zips (sandbox write restriction); no source files were changed.
